user_confirmation: 采用这套最小指令集和语义
wake_implementation: CPU exact text gate after ASR; no separate trained wake-word model in this candidate

auto_start.behavior: request automatic obstacle avoidance; perception/control implementation remains separate; speed and avoidance strategy are not configured here

stop.behavior: stop movement, exit automatic avoidance, clear queued/incomplete actions

missing_parameter: ask for the missing distance or angle; no movement
stop_wake_gate: while motion is active, exact 停车 does not require a new wake phrase
interaction_stop: retain existing stop-all generation cancellation, microphone/playback shutdown and explicit resume
resume: resumes interaction only; never resumes old vehicle commands
lateral_motion: unsupported; left/right are turns in degrees
synonym_expansion: none approved beyond the literal forms above
unconfirmed_or_ambiguous_text: reject; no action, including compound, negated, hypothetical or unsupported commands
quantity_representation: positive finite decimal; normalized SI value is data, not permission to execute
execution_limits_status: requires later feedback/controller and board validation; never invent duration from distance
